text: Sleep on it: wait at least 1 hour between first looking at a stock and buying it.
Do not place buys in the morning (6-11 h on your clock). Decide then if you like, and place the order at another time.
Do more research before you buy: look at the stock on at least about 3 occasions in the 30 days before (a conviction score of 2, the number on the watchlist's pills).
When you have looked at a stock on fewer than about 3 occasions in the last 30 days (a conviction score under 2), keep the buy to at most 0.5x your usual buy.
